subject: CIC Annual Meeting during WiFo 2023 � Call for Papers � Deadline extended to 16.03.

messages.author: Guessregen, Stefan /DE
messages.body:
Dear colleagues,
The next Computers in Chemistry (CIC) GDCh division annual meeting will take place on Tue, Sep 5, 2023 embedded into the largest congress of the GDCh, the �Wissenschaftsforum� (WiFo) 2023, Sep 4-6, 2023 in Leipzig, Germany (
https://www.wifo2023.de
<
https://www.wifo2023.de
>,
https://www.wifo2023.de/en
<
https://www.wifo2023.de/en
>).
The program includes the core topics of the CIC Division, ranging from quantum mechanics over molecular simulation quantum mechanics to artificial intelligence in drug discovery, chemistry, and material science. The meeting will be composed of three sessions, each of which will be introduced by invited speakers:
- Alain Vaucher (IBM Research, Switzerland)
- Antonia Mey (University of Edinburgh, UK)
- Thomas Fox (Boehringer-Ingelheim, Germany)
We are offering several slots for short contributed oral communications (12 min lecture plus 3 min discussion) within each session on Tue, Sep 5, and also encourage you to participate by submitting posters for the session on Mon, Sep 4. We will also celebrate year�s recipients of the CIC Award for Computational Chemistry.
Please submit your abstracts for short communications (extended deadline March 16, 2023) and posters (deadline May 2, 2023). Please contact cic-wifo2023.go.gdch.de<mailto:contact%20cic-wifo2023.go.gdch.de?subject=CIC-Annual%20Meeting%202023> for further questions.
We will be happy to meet you again in 2023 in Leipzig!
On behalf of the CIC Executive Board � the program coordinators
Stefan G�ssregen & Stefan M. Kast
